capacity_gross_kwh.notes: EV Database: 67.5 kWh nominal; Kia markets the pack as "64 kWh" (usable).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: EV Database: 64.0 kWh usable (EU listing 2020-2022; same 64 kWh pack as the 2019 NA car).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Weakest value in this batch. Kia added navigation-triggered battery conditioning with the EV6 (launched MY22, upgraded MY23, InsideEVs) and made it standard on the second-generation Niro EV (Kia Europe release, search excerpt); the 2019-2022 first-generation Niro EV predates the EV6 and I found no gen-1 Niro EV manual or Kia page describing battery conditioning for charging. A search snippet says MY19-21 has a PTC battery heater but no manual pre-heat. Silence is not proof; no better-supported value exists.

dc_max_kw.notes: Tested 2019 Niro EV, about 21 C: peaked about 77 kW (78 kW second session). Kia's '100 kW' is the charger rating in its 80 % time; EV Database lists 77 kW too. Kia states no car peak.

ac_max_kw.notes: Kia US debut release (search excerpt): 7.2 kW Level 2 charger; EV Database lists 7.2 kW standard for the EU e-Niro. 2020-2022 assumed the same (no onboard charger change found).
